requirements.text: The QoSStatement package has a QoSStatement class.
The QoSStatement package has a SingleQoSStatement class.
CoumpoundQoSStatement is a class which belongs to QoSStatement package
Parameter is a class which belongs to QoSStatement package
My domain defines the possible types of qualifications. They have a value, which is a string.
QoSStatement is a superclass of all classes that describe various kind of objets, either simple or compound, that representing quality of services.
The QoSStatement package has a QoSStatement class. Each QoSStatement class has a CompoundQoSStatement to which it is related.
The QoSStatement package has a SingleQoSStatement class. Each SingleQoSStatement class is composed of a QoSContraint.
A CoumpoundQoSStatement is composed of 2 or more QoSStatements
Every QoS constraint should be qualified, according to its kind. A particular type (QualificationKind) describes the possible kinds.
